label: one-slot automatic pipeline lookahead
hypothesis: Reduce automatic pipeline host/device working set to one slot while using the interval after k+m release for the next gather/H2D; test whether four-group lookahead is unnecessary and adds memory/cache pressure.
expected_bottleneck: Four pinned and device slots retain 32/256/512 MiB each at b1/b8/b16; actual producer/consumer wait profiles and component transfer costs motivate testing a smaller bounded working set.
change: Add automatic pipeline depth limit=1. Leave explicit manual pipeline depth, bulk decode, group size, event flags/order and lookup semantics unchanged.
tradeoffs: Pipeline pinned and GPU buffers decrease 75%; lost lookahead can cause compute stalls.
Memory savings alone do not qualify: require repeated primary prefill latency and gap reduction.
